title: Community Event: Torrentrueno Kart Race Challenge
names_seen: Community Event: Torrentrueno Kart Race Challenge

facts.statement: A weekly community event asked players to race karts at the Torrentrueno racing circuit, where the winner takes the whole race.
facts.quote: el evento comunitario de esta semana será de extrema velocidad, donde el ganador se lleva toda la carrera

facts.statement: The event ran on Thursday 27 January 2011 at 15:00 Pacific Time for the US and Latin America, on Server 1.
facts.quote: jueves 27 de enero del 2011 15:00 Tiempo Pacifico (EE.UU. y Latino America) Servidor 1

facts.statement: The event ran on Friday 28 January 2011 at 09:00 Pacific Time (16:00 European Time) for the UK and Europe, on Server 1.
facts.quote: viernes 28 de enero del 2011 09:00 Tiempo Pacifico / 16:00 Tiempo Europeo (UK y Europa) Servidor 1

article_summaries.title: Evento Comunitario: Reto en el Circuito de Carreras de Torrentrueno
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language community event announcement (page title in the archive: 'Free Realms - What is New?') for a kart race contest at the Torrentrueno racing circuit. Players teleport to the circuit, use the Kart Lobby icon to join or create a race, and set a player-vs-player race by setting max players and turning off 'Habilitar IA' (AI). The event ran on Thursday 27 January 2011 (US and Latin America, 15:00 Pacific) and Friday 28 January 2011 (UK and Europe, 09:00 Pacific / 16:00 European), both on Server 1.
